name: My Mario Game
storyline:
Something I like to do when I have free time is look for old games on internet forums. It's interesting to me to see what amateur games made in Game Maker were like in the early 2000s, and occasionally I come across things so ridiculous that they're funny.

One night, when I was searching for games on abandoned forums, I had come across a post posted by a user called “EpicScottGames”. The article had the title “My Mario Game”, the only thing it had was an executable file with the same name and a description that said the following:

“Hi guys, this is my first video game.

My name is Scott, and I am 14 years old. I really like Super Mario games and I have a dream to work at Nintendo, so I wanted to start making games. This is my first game and it's called "Super Mario Adventure"

I have tried the game and I can say that it is worth taking a look, for an amateur game it is quite good. I hope to contact Scott at some point.
summary: Surrealistic Mario game based on janky indie fangames from the 2000s.
